full_judgment:
ABM Khairul Haque J :This is a Petition for Leave to Appeal in respect of the Judgment and Order dated 20-8-2008, passed by the High Court Division in rejecting an application under Section 561 A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 5880 of 2007. 

 2. The facts of the case, in brief, are that the Executive Engineer of the Roads and Highway Department, Shimrail, Narayanganj, filed a Complaint Case, alleging that the petitioner as the lessee of the Meghna-Gumti Bridge kept the toll money of Taka 2,85,12,500 without depositing the same in favour of the Roads and Highway Department. The Sessions Judge, on consideration of the materials on record, framed charge against the petitioner under sections 409/420 of the Penal Code. This was challenged under section 561 A of the Code of Criminal Procedure. 

 6. There is no legal impediment to file a criminal case even if a civil suit is pending on the self- same allegations provided the ingredients of the offence are present. In the present case, the civil suit had also been dismissed for default and only a miscellaneous case for its restoration is pending.
